description: Record a field test result (LTHR, LT1, HRmax, FTP…) effective from a date; ask the user before saving. Stored in the local database only, never sent to Garmin; a row with the same date, param and source stays as it is (added false). A backdated row recomputes earlier activities from its date on (the first garmin-auto row is the Garmin profile as of its first download). Returns the row and the value in effect today. Example: {"date":"2026-10-11","param":"lthr_run","value":171,"note":"30 min TT"}.

date.description: Day of the test, not in the future

param.description: Heart rates in bpm, ftp_w/run_ftp_w in W, css_s_per_100m in s per 100 m, run_threshold_pace_s_per_km in s per km

name: set_threshold
title: Record a threshold
